mapper.select: select c.id, c.blog_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.nick_name as author_name, u.icon as author_icon from blog_comment c left join user u on u.id = c.user_id where c.blog_id = #{blogId} order by c.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select c.id, c.blog_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.nick_name as author_name, u.icon as author_icon from blog_comment c left join user u on u.id = c.user_id where c.id = #{id}
select count(*) from blog_comment where blog_id = #{blogId}

select c.id, c.blog_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.nick_name as author_name, u.icon as author_icon, b.title as blog_title, bu.nick_name as blog_author_name from blog_comment c left join user u on u.id = c.user_id join blog b on b.id = c.blog_id left join user bu on bu.id = b.user_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from blog_comment where user_id = #{userId}
